The '''2018 Bespin Regionals''' was held on 14 July 2018, the first day of the Bespin Super Weekend, organized by [[Mark Walseth]].<ref name="bespin18">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1201641#p1201641 Bespin Super Weekend - July 14th / 15th], Walsetmd, Players Committee forum (14 July 2018). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122224810/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1201641.html Internet Archive]</ref> Jake took the title, and Bryan wanted the voucher.<ref name="bespin18" />
